name: Supplier quality response check
summary: A quality or purchasing person who has raised a defect with a supplier gets the supplier's reply set against the finding: what is answered, what is not, the evidence still to ask for, the actions proposed and what has yet to be verified. The person decides whether the answer is accepted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of checking a supplier's reply to a quality finding, and its own rules for prepared work: a fixed finding record with stated labels, a stop when an input does not match, every statement in the reply numbered and set against the request it answers, a promised action never counted as a completed or verified one, every gap written as a question or a request for evidence, and nothing accepted, sent, closed or changed until a person decides.
